scenes.name: hook
scenes.text: You swipe up, and the next reel is weirdly perfect for you. But how did Instagram pick it?

scenes.name: cand
scenes.text: First, it gathers thousands of possible reels, mostly from accounts you don't even follow.

scenes.name: signals
scenes.text: It looks at your recent activity. What you watched to the end, liked, shared, or skipped fast.

scenes.name: predict
scenes.text: For each reel, models predict chances. Will you watch it fully, like it, send it to a friend, or open its audio?

scenes.name: score
scenes.text: Those chances are weighted and added into one score. Sends to friends count a lot, Instagram says.

scenes.name: filter
scenes.text: Then it removes reels that break guidelines, and mixes things up, so you don't get the same creator back to back.

scenes.name: learn
scenes.text: Whatever you do with this reel becomes a new signal, so the feed keeps adjusting as you scroll.

scenes.name: outro
scenes.text: Gather, predict, score, filter. A new guess every swipe. Follow for more on how things really work.
